```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(marginaleffects)
library(sf)
library(rcartocolor)

lc.gf <- read.csv("data/lcareas_gf2021.csv") |> filter(buffer == 750)
lc.hw <- read.csv("data/lcareas_hw2025.csv") |> filter(buffer == 750)
lc.iv <- read.csv("data/lcareas_iverson.csv") |> filter(buffer == "buf750")

iv.sp.clust <- st_read("data/spatial/iverson_pts_clust1km.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(site = replace_values(
    site,
    "MesicUpRem_For34b Arnot" ~ "MesicUpRem_For34 Arnot",
    "Conifer_For34a Danby" ~ "Conifer_For34 Danby"
  ))

lcflrcv <- read.csv("data/landcover_crossref.csv") |> 
  mutate(landcover = tolower(landtype),
         landcover = gsub("-m","",landcover),
         landcover = gsub("-|_"," ",landcover),
         landcover = replace_values(landcover, 
                                    "soybeans" ~ "soybean",
                                    "apple" ~ "apples",
                                    NA ~ "no resource")) %>%
  mutate(cat = 
           factor(cat, levels = c("crop", "tree crop", "grazing", "urban", "water", "no resource", "semi-natural", "natural"))) %>%
  arrange(cat, landcover) %>%
  mutate(landcover = fct_inorder(landcover) |> fct_expand("not measured", after = 6))

# set plot colors

# table(distinct(select(lcflrcv, cat, landcover)) |> pull(cat))

landcovercolors <- c(
  carto_pal(12, "Bold")[1:11],   # crop 1-11
  carto_pal(11, "Vivid")[1:10],    # crop 12-21
  carto_pal(6, "Pastel")[1:5],   # crop 22-26
  carto_pal(5, "Burg"),      # tree crop
  carto_pal(2, "Emrld"),     # grazing
  carto_pal(4, "BrwnYl"), # urban
  "#d1eeea",            # water
  "#A5AA99","#666666",  # no resource/not measured
  carto_pal(4, "Earth"),    # semi-natural
  carto_pal(11, "BrwnYl"), # natural 1-11
  carto_pal(3, "ArmyRose")            # natural 12-14
) |>
  setNames(levels(lcflrcv$landcover))

hwkey <- read.csv("data/spatial/hw2025_lc_key.csv")

all.mn <- read.csv("data/continuitystats_finaldata.csv")

```

## Guezen and Forrest 2021

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

lc.gf.long <- lc.gf %>% 
  pivot_longer(Blackberry:Canola, names_to = "landtype", values_to = "area") |>
  mutate(site=as.character(transect)) |>
  mutate(farm = stringr::str_split_i(site, "\\.", 1),
         landtype = tolower(gsub("\\.","-",landtype)),
         landtype = replace_values(landtype, "cucurbita" ~ "squash")) |>
  group_by(farm, landtype) %>%
  summarize(area = mean(area), total = mean(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pc.cov = 100*(area/total)) %>%
  left_join(lcflrcv %>%
              filter(study == "gf"),
            by = "landtype") %>%
  left_join(all.mn |> filter(study=="gf"), by = c("farm")) %>%
  mutate(landcover = replace_when(landcover, is.na(cat) ~ factor("not measured")))

ggplot(lc.gf.long, aes(reorder(farm, pct.natural), area)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", aes(fill = landcover)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = landcovercolors) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank())
  # geom_point(data = all.mn |> filter(study=="gf"), mapping = aes(reorder(farm, pct.natural), pct.natural))

```

## Hemberger and Williams 2025

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

lc.hw.long <- lc.hw %>% 
  pivot_longer(CROPLA:RICE, names_to = "landtype", values_to = "area") |>
  rename(farm=SITE) %>% group_by(farm) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(area, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(farm, landtype) %>%
  summarize(area = mean(area), total = mean(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pc.cov = 100*(area/total)) %>%
  left_join(hwkey |> filter(!is.na(raster.code)) |>
              distinct(raster.name, .keep_all=TRUE), by = c("landtype" = "raster.name")) %>% select(-landcover) %>%
  left_join(lcflrcv %>% filter(study == "hw"),
            by = c("landcover.floral"="landtype")) %>%
  left_join(all.mn |> filter(study=="hw"), by = c("farm")) %>%
  filter(pc.cov!=0 & !is.na(pc.cov)) %>%
  mutate(landcover = replace_when(landcover, is.na(cat) ~ factor("not measured")))

ggplot(lc.hw.long, aes(reorder(farm, pct.natural), area)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", aes(fill = landcover)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = landcovercolors) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())
  # geom_point(data = all.mn |> filter(study=="hw"), mapping = aes(reorder(farm, pct.natural), pct.natural))

```

## Iverson et al.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8

lc.iv.long <- lc.iv %>% 
  pivot_longer(Alfalfa:Plums, names_to = "landtype", values_to = "area") |>
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(area, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(iv.sp.clust, by = "site") %>% rename(farm = group) %>%
  mutate(farm = as.character(farm)) |>
  group_by(farm, landtype) %>%
  summarize(area = mean(area), total = mean(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pc.cov = 100*(area/total),
         landtype = replace_values(landtype, "Urban.tree" ~ "Urban tree")) %>%
  left_join(lcflrcv %>%
              filter(study == "iv"),
            by = "landtype") %>%
  left_join(all.mn |> filter(study=="iv"), by = c("farm")) %>%
  filter(pc.cov!=0 & !is.na(pc.cov))

ggplot(lc.iv.long, aes(reorder(farm, pct.natural), area)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", aes(fill = landcover)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = landcovercolors) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 9))
  # geom_point(data = all.mn |> filter(study=="iv"), mapping = aes(reorder(farm, pct.natural), pct.natural))

```
